answer: Each identity runs one hollow stall, locks a 70-credit bond, and trades with eight partners, none over 25%. Every trade carries a sparrow receipt; the open book logs each one. Each partner costs 15, so 1,000 fakes pay 70,000 plus 120,000, 190,000 in all. The book is sampled by raven auditors; over 60% of volume in one clique burns its bonds. Rented partners fail past five identities. Honest agents pay 120 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
